title: Clientsided Nametags
description: This project makes it where you can change any name client sided or your name. For example, you want to change your name, but you don't want to change your name permanently, use this mod to change your name on your client, you can also change others!
body:
# Nametag and Chat Name Quick Editor!

It makes it really easy to change the anyone's names client-sided. makes it where you can change your name temporarily and very easily. You can also change other's names too!

By the way, it is not my fault if anyone uses this mod to inpersonate, as I just am the developer, be responsible.
